_doc: P-86 gem test labels. Key = path of the note, then 1-based file line number. Value = [label, source or reason, mixed]. Label D = DERIVABLE (the fact is present in the named source at the note's time), G = GEM (absent from the sources and a fresh session would get it wrong), U = UNSURE (partly present, or absent but low impact, or present only outside the brief's sources). A line with several facts gets the worst label (G over U over D); mixed=1 marks a non-D line that also holds derivable clauses. Repo state used per note is in the 'at' field.
